Subject: SDET candidate — availability & panel needs

Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for taking a look at our SDET candidate (resume attached). Recruiter Avery sent the profile last night; candidate is excited about the role and can interview next Wednesday (6/2) or Thursday (6/3) afternoon Pacific.

We need a 4-slot panel: a coding exercise (45m), system design (30m), product/ownership (30m), and bar-raiser/culture (30m). Two of those can be combined if necessary (we prefer coding separate).

Can you confirm who from your side can own: coding, system design, and product? Also flag any conflicts with the dates above.

Thanks —
Caroline Smith
Talent Partner, Acme Ads
Attachments: resume_jd_sdet.pdf
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: SDET candidate — availability & panel needs

Caroline — thanks, got the resume. Quick notes:

- I can cover the coding exercise (45m). Prefer to run the candidate through a short pairing task and a couple of system-tests-focused questions.
- Karthik can do system design but is out Wednesday morning; Thursday afternoon looks ok for him (cc'd).
- For product/ownership slot I want Marissa to weigh in as she owns the QA/product interface (Marissa, can you take that?)

If Marissa can't, Laura can be our fallback for product/ownership or bar-raiser. We should nominate a bar-raiser who isn't directly owning the role — Laura, would you be open to that if needed?

I attached a very quick priority matrix request (panel_matrix.xlsx) — fill the columns: primary, secondary, absolute no for each slot so we can finalize. Also please confirm time windows (Wed 6/2 1:00-4:30pm PT, Thu 6/3 12:30-5:00pm PT).

Jonas
Principal Hiring Partner — Redwood Inference
